FULL DREAD

These only happen in the very worst water. Switch each one on or off, or press Try to jump to full dread with just that effect. Press 0 in game to stop a test.

KEYS

CONTROLS

A / D, ← →Steer
W / S, ↑ ↓Let the sails out / reef them. With oars out: row forward / back water
GOars out / in (row in a dead calm or up to a pier)
EGo ashore at a pier, dig, pick fruit, salvage, hail a ship (works under way: the anchor goes down by itself)
CFishing: cast, hook the fish, hold Space to reel
Space or EnterContinue / close Mara's text
SpaceFire cannons at an attacking raider (auto-aimed)
1 / 2Choose on an encounter card
Space / HDice at the tavern: roll / hold. Space also throws the die at the hut
M / JCaptain's log: M = map, J = quests (tabs on the bookmarks)
QShow / hide the mission tracker
YAsk Mara for a hint
Esc or PPause
Mouse drag, R / FTilt camera; drag sideways to look around the ship
Z / X / VLook left / right / ahead again
Mouse wheel, - / =Zoom out / in
HHide the HUD
TouchOn-screen buttons
Left stickSteer (as far as you push) and the sails; in a menu, move
A / BInteract / nothing at sea; in a menu, press / back
X / YFishing / captain's log
RT / LTStrike, fire, go on / oars
LB / RB, right stickLook around; right stick up and down zooms. In a menu, LB / RB change the tab
ViewTracker; hold it to ask Mara for a hint
Start, left stick pressPause, the lamp

Wind: the ring at the top right is gold where she sails well and red into the wind; the arrow is the wind, the triangle your bow. The wind shifts over time.
Treasure: read the riddle in the log, stop at the right shore and press E.
Dev: the bar at the top sets the quest, the hour and the dread (auto = by distance again, or 0); 1-4 dawn / noon / dusk / night, [ ] change the hour, , . previous / next quest, F7 finish the quest, F6 weather (clear, light rain, storm, auto), ` info line, F8 sound mixer, F9 sound studio.

Enter to choose

THREADS (DEV)

Which dark threads are awake in this voyage. The setting is remembered in this browser and applies when you press Set sail. A thread marked "not built" has no game yet.
